verdict.rationale: Spline's docs say it is "multiplayer from the ground up": several people can edit the same cloud file at once, with "real-time collaboration" shared across both editors. That covers the core of simultaneous team editing with live sync. Live cursors are never mentioned, and there is no hands-on or independent confirmation of sync speed or behavior. missing for 10: documented live cursors/presence indicators, independent or hands-on corroboration of instant sync.

support.subject: As a designer, my whole team can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync

citations.quote: is multiplayer from the ground up: your files live in the cloud and several people can edit the same one at once
Spline is two editors that share the same interactivity model, the same real-time collaboration, and the same publishing pipeline.
Several people can edit the same file at the same time and give feedback in place, the way they would in a 2D design tool.
